original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.
Only changing helper terminal subspaces and monotone frames within the fixed scalar word, entrances and cleanup contract already covered by #1995/#2013.

Continuing a partial cost improvement while leaving the same unpriced consumer, restoration or central-readout obligation unresolved; refresh the family expansion decision first. Local product-retiming evidence has a narrow scope and is not a ban on changed graphs or contracts.

actual_scope: Audit the outer caller admission of PR2013's exact four-end attaining assignment: derive each changed end's source register and last-use containment, then compare the complete annotated frames against the earlier physically admitted two-end recipe.
scope_change_reason: The assigned scope is a complementary caller-interface audit of a concrete prior changed-end proposal, not a new helper inventory or moment grid. It closes the handoff's explicitly open physical-hosting question at the boundary-map level and stops when the missing outer owner receipt is established.
bottleneck_link: A rank saving is admissible only if its caller supplies, consumes and restores every exposed register at the changed interface. The four-end moment uses four less local rank units, which the coverage law recharges as idle mass; the unresolved owner schedule determines whether any physical gain remains.
stop_rule: Stop after all four changed-end source containments and the two-end recipe comparison. Do not expand to a new construction or full replay when the exact four-end candidate has no owner map/outer invoice and differs at 149 additional frame annotations.
evidence: verify.py checks the four source registers (412, 414, 424, 86), their B994-B997 last-use frames and all four exact containments; it verifies local/idle mass conservation; and it finds 149 additional frame changes beyond the earlier two-end physical recipe. The local frame proposal is not covered by that prior outer caller admission.

open_questions.question: Can a whole-call owner schedule admit the exact four-end annotated word while preserving the selected interface, dirty-state restoration and outer invoice?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The exact local rank profile and cone containments do not pay for source windows, copies, owner lifetimes, restoration, phase/wrapper code or recursive hosting; those obligations decide whether the changed endpoints are physically realizable.
open_questions.first_step: Bind registers 412, 414, 424 and port 86 to their whole-call owners and source windows, emit and admit the exact four-end word through native phase/wrapper checks, then run the complete owner and outer invoice.
open_questions.blocked_by: The pinned four-end assignment has no complete physical owner allocation or outer-call receipt, and its 149 additional changed frame annotations are outside the earlier two-end recipe.
